Keep reading—we’d love to tell you more!As a warehouse associate at DSV, you’ll be responsible for:    - Conducting visual inspections of cell phones and other electronic devices     - Recording and processing information in the computer system     - Assisting at charging stations where phones are charged     - Inspecting devices for visible damage or defects     - Carefully processing administrative data     - Working in accordance with applicable quality and safety guidelinesWhat's in it for you    - A gross hourly wage of €15.55    - Temporary contract through Manpower with the possibility of being hired directly by DSV    - Full-time opportunities (40 hours per week)     - Travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometer (maximum of 30 kilometers one way)     - Pension plan through Manpower     - Opportunities for career growth and development     - Annual Christmas gift basket    - Opportunities for personal development through the Manpower Academy (more than 200 online training courses)    - Work in a pleasant and supportive work environmentFor this position, it is important that you:    - Have a good command of Dutch and/or English    - Are available to work 40 hours per week    - Are able to apply for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG)    - Are able to perform tasks while sitting or standing    - Have a precise and meticulous work ethicWould you like to work as a warehouse associate at DSV? Apply now! One of our Manpower colleagues will contact you within two business days.
